moves.change: Market data is stored once and shared by every workspace
moves.reason: Market data is stored once: workspaces keep a version index into the shared catalog instead of their own copies, and a research input's key names the market data it was sealed from, as a BLAKE3 digest of its values. Every value is unchanged, proved by replaying a real workspace's 185,251 records with all values equal.
